# Insidia Labs

> Local CLI that scans an AI app and the application around it, then writes one HTML report. Insidia Cloud, the hosted attacker, is a later product.

The CLI is the contract. An agent installs it from GitHub, keeps the scan inside the hosts named in `insidia.yaml`, and opens the report.

## Start

- [Use a coding agent](https://docs.insidialabs.com/start/agent/): skill install, the prompt to paste, and the rules for scope
- [Install](https://docs.insidialabs.com/start/install/): `uv tool install` or `pipx` from the git URL
- [Quickstart](https://docs.insidialabs.com/start/quickstart/): init, doctor, scan, report
- [Scope](https://docs.insidialabs.com/start/scope/): localhost is the default. Other hosts need `authorized: true`

## Reference

- [CLI](https://docs.insidialabs.com/reference/cli/): commands, exit codes, and `insidia mcp`
- [GitHub Action](https://github.com/Rushi-Balapure/Insidia-Labs/blob/main/actions/scan/action.yml): `uses: Rushi-Balapure/Insidia-Labs/actions/scan@v0`
